Package it.unipv.posfw.orbit.dao

Class DAOFactory

java.lang.Object
it.unipv.posfw.orbit.dao.DAOFactory
public class DAOFactory extends Object
Abstract Factory Singleton responsible for providing instances of Data Access Objects (DAOs). Ensures low coupling by hiding the concrete database implementation from the domain logic.
